model: Hyken Chair (Union & Scale UN59460 to UN59465)
notes: Two Union & Scale assembly guides cover the family: UN59461, UN59463 and UN59465 have an upright seat tilt lock, UN59460, UN59462 and UN59464 (and V variants) a variable-position one, and both list the same parts. The nylon base and mesh seat and back come from a Quill listing for item 901-24328579 (model ST63139), which is tied to the UN59460/62/64 guide only by that item number in the guide's file name.

gaps: The Quill listing calls it a Staples Hyken mesh task chair and names no Union & Scale or UN model number. Only the item number 24328579 in the UN59460/62/64 guide's file name links it to a guide, so the nylon and mesh claims are stated for that Quill item.

Quill conflicts: capacity is 275 lb in the spec table and description but 'up to 300 lbs' in the key specs; warranty is 7 years in the spec table but 5 years in the description. The guides' warranty says 7 years and users up to 275 lb (124 kg).
The file name of the UN59461/63/65 guide carries 990119; the Staples page for that item was not read (the researcher reported HTTP 403).
Neither guide gives the gas lift's class, stroke or maker, caster size, or screw sizes.
No tilt spring is claimed: both guides describe a tilt tension knob under the front centre of the seat, not a spring.
Neither guide names a base or seat material.
method: Hyken Chair assembly guide, UN59461 | UN59463 | UN59465 (Staples marketing PDF, English and French), read with research tool pdf: features and tilt controls (PDF page 3), included parts and hardware (page 4), warranty (page 6).
Hyken Chair assembly guide, UN59460 | UN59462 | UN59464 and V variants (Staples marketing PDF), read the same way; included parts and hardware match the first guide.
Quill listing, item 901-24328579, model ST63139 (WebFetch, twice): spec table base, seat and back material, capacity and warranty, and the description.
Third-party manual sites were not used for any claim.

comps.spec: Gas lift (x1), included-parts item 5 in both guides; the warranty lists a pneumatic cylinder among the covered parts
Five casters (x5), included-parts item 7 in both guides
Base (x1), included-parts item 6 in both guides; Quill item 901-24328579 (model ST63139) lists a nylon base and describes a five-star base with casters
Screws in the parts pack as printed in both guides: yellow x6, blue x4, green x3 and a fourth pack (D) x2; the tools provided include one Allen wrench
Mesh seat and back on Quill item 901-24328579 (model ST63139, described as a Staples Hyken mesh task chair)
